published.citation: Esteves et al. 2015, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KOI-13 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive: 7650 +/- 250 K, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...804..150E/abstract

temperature.note: Kepler-13 B lies 1.2 arcsec away and gives 47% of the light (WDS 19079+4652, Mason et al. 2001): every spectrum and catalogue color of the star blends the two, so the color is taken from its own temperature, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
